INSERT INTO trade_order_item ( order_no, user_id, spu_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, spec_json, sku_image_url, quantity, sale_price_yuan, line_amount_yuan, point_exchange_enabled, point_exchange_points, line_points, is_hot_sku, created_at ) SELECT raw.order_no, raw.user_id, raw.spu_id, decode(raw.sku_id_hex, 'hex'), raw.sku_code, raw.sku_name, CAST(raw.spec_json AS jsonb), raw.sku_image_url, raw.quantity, raw.sale_price_yuan, raw.line_amount_yuan, COALESCE(raw.point_exchange_enabled, FALSE), COALESCE(raw.point_exchange_points, 0), COALESCE(raw.line_points, 0), raw.is_hot_sku, to_timestamp(raw.created_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( order_no text, user_id bigint, spu_id bigint, sku_id_hex text, sku_code text, sku_name text, spec_json text, sku_image_url text, quantity integer, sale_price_yuan numeric, line_amount_yuan numeric, point_exchange_enabled boolean, point_exchange_points bigint, line_points bigint, is_hot_sku boolean, created_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ON CONFLICT (order_no, sku_id) DO NOTHING

paid_at, closing_at, closing_deadline_at, cancelled_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at, version ) SELECT raw.order_no, raw.user_id, raw.status, raw.total_amount_yuan, raw.discount_amount_yuan, raw.pay_amount_yuan, COALESCE(raw.required_points, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(raw.payment_type, ''), 'UNPAID'), COALESCE(raw.used_points, 0), CASE WHEN raw.user_coupon_id_hex IS NULL OR THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(raw.paid_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, CASE WHEN raw.closing_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(raw.closing_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, CASE WHEN raw.closing_deadline_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(raw.closing_deadline_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, CASE WHEN raw.cancelled_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(raw.cancelled_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, CASE WHEN raw.closed_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(raw.closed_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, to_timestamp(raw.created_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0), to_timestamp(raw.updated_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0), GREATEST(raw.version, 1) FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{ordersJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( order_no text, user_id bigint, status text, total_amount_yuan numeric, discount_amount_yuan numeric, pay_amount_yuan numeric, required_points bigint, payment_type text, used_points bigint, user_coupon_id_hex text, idempotency_key text, expire_at_epoch_ms bigint, paid_at_epoch_ms bigint, closing_at_epoch_ms bigint, closing_deadline_at_epoch_ms bigint, cancelled_at_epoch_ms bigint, closed_at_epoch_ms bigint, created_at_epoch_ms bigint, updated_at_epoch_ms bigint, version bigint ) ORDER BY raw.created_at_epoch_ms, raw.order_no ON CONFLICT (order_no) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, total_amount_yuan = EXCLUDED.total_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan = EXCLUDED.discount_amount_yuan, pay_amount_yuan = EXCLUDED.pay_amount_yuan, required_points = EXCLUDED.required_points, payment_type = EXCLUDED.payment_type, used_points = EXCLUDED.used_points, user_coupon_id = EXCLUDED.user_coupon_id, idempotency_key = EXCLUDED.idempotency_key, expire_at = EXCLUDED.expire_at, paid_at = EXCLUDED.paid_at, closing_at = EXCLUDED.closing_at, closing_deadline_at = EXCLUDED.closing_deadline_at, cancelled_at = EXCLUDED.cancelled_at, closed_at = EXCLUDED.closed_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, version = GREATEST(trade_order.version, EXCLUDED.version) WHERE trade_order.status <> 'PAID' OR EXCLUDED.status = 'PAID'

INSERT INTO trade_order_item ( order_no, user_id, spu_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, spec_json, sku_image_url, quantity, sale_price_yuan, line_amount_yuan, point_exchange_enabled, point_exchange_points, line_points, is_hot_sku, created_at ) SELECT raw.order_no, raw.user_id, raw.spu_id, decode(raw.sku_id_hex, 'hex'), raw.sku_code, raw.sku_name, CAST(raw.spec_json AS jsonb), raw.sku_image_url, raw.quantity, raw.sale_price_yuan, raw.line_amount_yuan, COALESCE(raw.point_exchange_enabled, FALSE), COALESCE(raw.point_exchange_points, 0), COALESCE(raw.line_points, 0), raw.is_hot_sku, to_timestamp(raw.created_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( order_no text, user_id bigint, spu_id bigint, sku_id_hex text, sku_code text, sku_name text, spec_json text, sku_image_url text, quantity integer, sale_price_yuan numeric, line_amount_yuan numeric, point_exchange_enabled boolean, point_exchange_points bigint, line_points bigint, is_hot_sku boolean, created_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ORDER BY raw.created_at_epoch_ms, raw.order_no, raw.sku_id_hex ON CONFLICT (order_no, sku_id) DO NOTHING

mapper.sql: id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", expire_at AS "expireAt", paid_at AS "paidAt", closing_at AS "closingAt", closing_deadline_at AS "closingDeadlineAt", cancelled_at AS "cancelledAt", closed_at AS "closedAt", version, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS "id", o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.user_id AS "userId", o.status, o.total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", o.discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", o.pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", o.required_points AS "requiredPoints", o.payment_type AS "paymentType", o.used_points AS "usedPoints", encode(o.user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", o.idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", o.expire_at AS "expireAt", o.paid_at AS "paidAt", o.closing_at AS "closingAt", o.closing_deadline_at AS "closingDeadlineAt", o.cancelled_at AS "cancelledAt", o.closed_at AS "closedAt", o.version, o.created_at AS "createdAt", o.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_no = o.order_no WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND i.sku_id = #{skuId} AND o.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'STOCK_CONFIRMING') AND (o.expire_at IS NULL OR o.expire_at > #{now}) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", spu_id AS "spuId", encode(sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", sku_code AS "skuCode", sku_name AS "skuName", spec_json::text AS "specJson", sku_image_url AS "skuImageUrl", quantity, sale_price_yuan AS "salePriceYuan", line_amount_yuan AS "lineAmountYuan", point_exchange_enabled AS "pointExchangeEnabled", point_exchange_points AS "pointExchangePoints", line_points AS "linePoints", is_hot_sku AS "hotSku", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM trade_order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "itemCount", COALESCE(BOOL_AND(point_exchange_enabled), FALSE) AS "pointExchangeAvailable", COALESCE(SUM(line_points), 0) AS "requiredPoints" FROM trade_order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

UPDATE user_point_account SET available_points = available_points - #{usedPoints}, total_used_points = total_used_points + #{usedPoints}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND available_points >= #{usedPoints} RETURNING id, user_id AS "userId", available_points AS "availablePoints", total_earned_points AS "totalEarnedPoints", total_used_points AS "totalUsedPoints", version

SELECT o.id AS "id", o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.user_id AS "userId", o.status, o.total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", o.discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", o.pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", o.required_points AS "requiredPoints", encode(o.user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", o.expire_at AS "expireAt", o.paid_at AS "paidAt", o.closing_at AS "closingAt", o.closing_deadline_at AS "closingDeadlineAt", o.cancelled_at AS "cancelledAt", o.closed_at AS "closedAt", o.created_at AS "createdAt", first_item.sku_name AS "firstSkuName", first_item.sku_image_url AS "firstSkuImageUrl", COALESCE(item_count.item_count, 0) AS "itemCount" FROM trade_order o LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.sku_name, i.sku_image_url FROM trade_order_item i WHERE i.order_no = o.order_no ORDER BY i.created_at ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) first_item ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM trade_order_item i WHERE i.order_no = o.order_no ) item_count ON TRUE WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND (#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR o.status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT o.id AS "id", o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.user_id AS "userId", o.status, o.total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", o.discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", o.pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", o.required_points AS "requiredPoints", encode(o.user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", o.expire_at AS "expireAt", o.paid_at AS "paidAt", o.closing_at AS "closingAt", o.closing_deadline_at AS "closingDeadlineAt", o.cancelled_at AS "cancelledAt", o.closed_at AS "closedAt", o.created_at AS "createdAt", o.updated_at AS "updatedAt", first_item.sku_name AS "firstSkuName", first_item.sku_image_url AS "firstSkuImageUrl", COALESCE(item_count.item_count, 0) AS "itemCount" FROM trade_order o LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.sku_name, i.sku_image_url FROM trade_order_item i WHERE i.order_no = o.order_no ORDER BY i.created_at ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) first_item ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM trade_order_item i WHERE i.order_no = o.order_no ) item_count ON TRUE WHERE (#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR o.status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR o.order_no = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE (#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR order_no = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' RETURNING id, order_no, user_id, status, user_coupon_id ) SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'CLOSING', closing_at = #{now}, closing_deadline_at = #{closingDeadline}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expire_at <= #{now} RETURNING id, order_no, user_id, status, user_coupon_id ) SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'CLOSING' AND closing_deadline_at <= #{now} RETURNING id, order_no, user_id, status, user_coupon_id ) SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId" FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT', updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'STOCK_CONFIRMING' RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'STOCK_CONFIRMING' RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, #{paidAt}), payment_type = 'SIMULATED', used_points = 0, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CLOSING') RETURNING id, order_no, user_id, status, user_coupon_id, total_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, required_points, payment_type, used_points, true AS changed ) SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", changed AS "changed" FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", false AS "changed" FROM trade_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'PAID' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) LIMIT 1

WITH raw AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER () AS rn, callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at_epoch_ms, paid_amount_yuan FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{callbacksJson} AS jsonb)) AS callback( callback_no text, order_no text, external_trade_no text, payment_provider text, paid_at_epoch_ms bigint, paid_amount_yuan numeric ) ), updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order o SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = COALESCE(o.paid_at, to_timestamp(raw.paid_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0)), payment_type = 'SIMULATED', used_points = 0, updated_at = NOW(), version = o.version + 1 FROM raw WHERE o.order_no = raw.order_no AND o.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CLOSING') RETURNING raw.rn, raw.callback_no, raw.external_trade_no, raw.payment_provider, raw.paid_at_epoch_ms, raw.paid_amount_yuan, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.status, encode(o.user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS user_coupon_id, o.total_amount_yuan, o.discount_amount_yuan, o.pay_amount_yuan, o.required_points, o.payment_type, o.used_points, true AS changed ), existing AS ( SELECT raw.rn, raw.callback_no, raw.external_trade_no, raw.payment_provider, raw.paid_at_epoch_ms, raw.paid_amount_yuan, raw.order_no, o.user_id, COALESCE(o.status, 'NOT_FOUND') AS status, encode(o.user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS user_coupon_id, o.total_amount_yuan, o.discount_amount_yuan, o.pay_amount_yuan, o.required_points, o.payment_type, o.used_points FROM raw LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_no = raw.order_no WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM updated u WHERE u.callback_no = raw.callback_no ) ), classified AS ( SELECT rn, callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at_epoch_ms, paid_amount_yuan, user_id, status AS order_status, user_coupon_id, total_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, pay_amount_yuan, required_points, payment_type, used_points, true AS changed, 'PAID' AS outcome, NULL::text AS reason_code FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT rn, callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at_epoch_ms, paid_amount_yuan, user_id, status AS order_status, user_coupon_id, total_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, pay_amount_yuan, required_points, payment_type, used_points, false AS changed, CASE WHEN status = 'PAID' THEN 'PAID_IDEMPOTENT' ELSE 'REFUND_PENDING' END AS outcome, CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 'PAID_AFTER_ORDER_CLOSED' WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'PAID_AFTER_ORDER_CANCELLED' WHEN status = 'NOT_FOUND' THEN 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND_AFTER_PAID' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS reason_code FROM existing ) SELECT callback_no AS "callbackNo", order_no AS "orderNo", external_trade_no AS "externalTradeNo", payment_provider AS "paymentProvider", paid_at_epoch_ms AS "paidAtEpochMs", paid_amount_yuan AS "paidAmountYuan", user_id AS "userId", order_status AS "orderStatus", user_coupon_id AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", changed AS "changed", outcome AS "outcome", reason_code AS "reasonCode" FROM classified ORDER BY rn

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, #{paidAt}), payment_type = 'SIMULATED', used_points = 0, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' RETURNING id, order_no, user_id, status, user_coupon_id, total_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, required_points, payment_type, used_points, true AS changed ) SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", changed AS "changed" FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", false AS "changed" FROM trade_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PAID' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) LIMIT 1

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, #{paidAt}), payment_type = 'POINTS', required_points = CASE WHEN required_points > 0 THEN required_points ELSE #{usedPoints} END, used_points = #{usedPoints}, discount_amount_yuan = 0, user_coupon_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CLOSING') AND payment_type = 'UNPAID' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at >= #{requestReceivedAt}) RETURNING id, order_no, user_id, status, user_coupon_id, total_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, pay_amount_yuan, required_points, payment_type, used_points, true AS changed ) SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", changed AS "changed" FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT id AS "id", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", status, encode(user_coupon_id, 'hex') AS "userCouponId", total_amount_yuan AS "totalAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", pay_amount_yuan AS "payAmountYuan", required_points AS "requiredPoints", payment_type AS "paymentType", used_points AS "usedPoints", false AS "changed" FROM trade_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PAID' AND payment_type = 'POINTS' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) LIMIT 1
